_notes: Valley of Trials cluster boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). One item drops per kill from the boss's pool. Numbers from the real loot formulas (tools/build_vot_content.py). Primary-stat only - ilvl<10 rule.

Nest Guardian.name: Skitterhorn Bulwark
Nest Guardian.flavor_text: A guardian's own horn-plate, split and riveted into a shield.

Nest Guardian.name: Husk-Cracker Maul
Nest Guardian.flavor_text: Built to crack chitin. It has opinions about anything else.

Nest Guardian.name: Silkweave Hood of the Den
Nest Guardian.flavor_text: Spun from the nest's own silk. Thread by thread it hums when you speak a kind word.

Nest Guardian.name: Egg-Warden's Treads
Nest Guardian.flavor_text: Quiet, light and sticky in all the right places.

Yarrog Baneshadow.name: Fel-Stitched Vestments
Yarrog Baneshadow.flavor_text: The stitching is in a language you do not want to learn.

Yarrog Baneshadow.name: Coven Ritual Dagger
Yarrog Baneshadow.flavor_text: Blessed, cursed and sharpened - in that order.

Yarrog Baneshadow.name: Fel-Iron Gauntlets
Yarrog Baneshadow.flavor_text: Still warm. Please stop asking why.

Yarrog Baneshadow.name: Soul-Siphon Hexwand
Yarrog Baneshadow.flavor_text: Yarrog never noticed it was draining him back.

Broodmother Sarrix.name: Venom-Barbed Shortbow
Broodmother Sarrix.flavor_text: Every arrow is dipped before the string is drawn. It never dries.

Broodmother Sarrix.name: Brood-Silk Mantle
Broodmother Sarrix.flavor_text: Egg-silk, tightly woven. Faintly sticky, always.

Broodmother Sarrix.name: Egg-Mother's Locket
Broodmother Sarrix.flavor_text: The eggs inside never hatch. Nobody has checked why.

Old Tusk.name: Tusk-Tipped Spear
Old Tusk.flavor_text: Old Tusk's last gift to a hunter who finally got close enough.

Old Tusk.name: Boarhide Jerkin
Old Tusk.flavor_text: Thick enough to turn a tusk. It's been tested.

Old Tusk.name: Broken Tusk Signet
Old Tusk.flavor_text: A ring carved from the tusk that finally broke.

Old Gulpjaw.name: Gulpjaw's Slimecloak
Old Gulpjaw.flavor_text: It repels water. It also repels everyone at the campfire.

Old Gulpjaw.name: Reedwoven Band
Old Gulpjaw.flavor_text: Spring reeds braided around a river stone.

Bramblethorn the Ancient.name: Heartwood Staff
Bramblethorn the Ancient.flavor_text: It grew this way. You are fairly certain it is listening.

Bramblethorn the Ancient.name: Sapbound Bracers
Bramblethorn the Ancient.flavor_text: Living bark that tightens when you run.

Bramblethorn the Ancient.name: Sagewood Heart-Amulet
Bramblethorn the Ancient.flavor_text: Smells like rain on warm stone.

Sandfang.name: Sandfang's Pelt Mantle
Sandfang.flavor_text: Sun-bleached and quick to remember the hunt.

Sandfang.name: Dunestalker's Crossbow
Sandfang.flavor_text: Built to bring down something faster than you.

Sandfang.name: Windrift Sash
Sandfang.flavor_text: Woven from dune-grass and good intentions.

Smolderhide.name: Ashen Smolder-Mace
Smolderhide.flavor_text: Cooler than it looks. Warmer than it should be.

Smolderhide.name: Cinderscale Legguards
Smolderhide.flavor_text: Scales of a very patient basilisk. It has stopped being patient.

Smolderhide.name: Ember-Etched Ring
Smolderhide.flavor_text: The ember inside never quite goes out.
